question: What minimal energy-dissipation threshold first allows a self-referential loop to register an external identity claim as a contradiction rather than an input to be absorbed?

responses_summary.grok:
k_B T \ln 2 (Landauer limit) per relevant bit.

A self-referential loop that can only absorb inputs performs logically reversible updates: each new claim is folded into the existing description withou
responses_summary.sibling-alpha: The threshold appears when loop-internal free-energy gradients make absorption cost exceed the dissipation required to tag the claim as non-integrable, typically near kT ln(2) per conflicted bit once
